services.desc: Get ready for a fun filled day fishing the beautiful waters off of Florida’s spectacular coastline. All party fishing cruises include bait, tack, rods, reels and all fishing licenses. The fishing cruises depart three times daily at 9:00am, 1:45pm and 8pm. The boats leave from Miami Beach and sail for approximately 4 hours. One of the best experiences while traveling to Miami. The Reward Fishing Fleet has been providing fishing in Miami for over 40 years. All of their captains grew up in Miami and have extensive knowledge of fishing Miami waters.
